_comment: Square re-forming on rally. A SQUARE player infantry block (60 men, which square_files lays out at 8 files -- seven full ranks plus a centred 4-man rear rank) is staged already routing, with the enemy still a long way off. Same staging as row-major-rally-reform.json and for the same reason: a rout that happens IN contact gets pinned by enemy soldier-body pressure and ground down rather than pulling clear, so it shatters instead of rallying. Here nothing is inside the rally-contact radius, so its morale climbs back toward the rout baseline and it rallies at tick 200 (60 Hz dump basis) at about its full flee pace, its men's centroid at y 548.1. Each man pulls up from his run on his own at his braking rate (SoldierBodies.pull_up_rallied), and the unit then re-forms where they come to rest: its grid is laid out at their centroid, square to the way they were running, and the square's own cells are dealt from where the men stand (_ensure_square_slot_assignment, marked stale by deal_slots_where_men_stand). The block stands at (799.64, 472.5) at tick 360, about 76 wu past the rally, identical on seeds 0 to 4 (dense 2-tick FULL dumps, measured 2026-11-13 on #1949's branch). The position pin was (800.63, 488.5) for the old flight's anchor and its depth-reflection re-square, which the bottom-up flight (#1949) removed. A second, safe player unit well out of the rout-shock radius keeps the battle from declaring defeat while the infantry is routing. The router spawns at morale 22 rather than 5, so the rally comes before the block leaves this camera and the close sim tier.
